# 769. Max Chunks To Make Sorted

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxChunksToSorted(self, arr):
        """
        :type arr: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        max_num = 0
        for i, t in enumerate(arr):
            max_num = max(max_num, t)
            if i == max_num:
                ans += 1
        return ans
```
